title: Bound PTZ helper discovery during camera GUI startup
problem: A PTZ helper that does not exit blocks camera GUI startup forever and leaves subsequent launches unable to activate the frozen process.
reproduce: Make one executable PTZ helper hang and start the GUI; the baseline subprocess call has no timeout and never returns.
acceptance: Every helper probe has a finite bound, timeout produces a warning and empty controller list, and normal helper output remains unchanged.
repair: Pass a five-second timeout to subprocess.run, catch TimeoutExpired, log the skipped helper, and add focused standard-library tests.

selection.reason: A four-day-old hardware-user report has exact reproduction, deterministic acceptance, no competing PR, and a two-branch regression.

verification.limitations: BCL verifies both subprocess branches and Python syntax without GTK, D-Bus or a physical PTZ device. Upstream review must choose whether five seconds is the preferred user-facing bound.
verification.ownerCheck: Start the GUI with one PTZ helper intentionally blocked. Confirm a warning appears after five seconds, the window opens, and the remaining controllers are still available.
